topic: Day 34 — carousel — How you treat people who can't retaliate is the real character test

slides.text: Those who can't retaliate or reward you, specifically.
Power asymmetry removes the incentive for good behavior.
That absence of incentive is what makes it revealing.

caption:
How a person treats those who can't retaliate or reward them reveals more about character than how they treat their equals.

Follow for one of these a day.
